title: President Jokowi Officiates Operation of Whoosh High Speed Train

excerpts.text: President Joko “Jokowi” Widodo Monday (10/02) inaugurated the operation of the Jakarta-Bandung High Speed Train (KCJB), at KCJB Halim Station, East Jakarta.

Following his remarks, President Jokowi pressed the siren button to mark the official inauguration of the KCJB. Afterward, President Jokowi and First Lady *Ibu* Iriana along with a limited entourage departed for Padalarang Station, West Bandung regency.

For the record, *Whoosh* is the first high-speed train in Indonesia and Southeast Asia that can travel up to 350 kilometers per hour. The train that connects Jakarta and Bandung runs for 142.3 kilometers and stops at four stations: Halim, Karawang, Padalarang, and Tegalluar.
